config_name: Legion 5i 15.3 — Core Ultra 7 251HX / RTX 5070 8GB, 32GB DDR5, 1TB SSD, 15.3" WQXGA IPS 165Hz HDR

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB GDDR7 (~115W Legion TGP, MUX)
specs.ports: 2x USB-C (DP, PD; no Thunderbolt/USB4 on Intel Legion 5 models), 3x USB-A, HDMI, RJ45 GbE, 3.5mm

battery.notes: ~80 Wh class. Inferred from NBC Gen 10 chassis testing; RTX 5070 tier shaves ~0.5h vs 5060. Arrow Lake-HX ~6.5-7h WiFi est.

offers.name: Lenovo Legion 5i 15.3" 165Hz HDR Gaming Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 251HX - 32GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - RTX 5070 - Windows 11 - Eclipse Black

reviews.quote: Its gaming performance is on par with the more expensive Legion 5 Pro 16.

professional.note: No pro review found for the 15.3" Gen 11 IPS chassis (honest disclosure per SHARED-legion5-ips.md); the NBC 15IRX10 RTX 5070 review (87%) anchors gaming.

praises: Full-TGP RTX 5070 at ~$3,000 on sale with 32GB RAM standard — one of the best all-round gaming specs per dollar at BBY right now
NBC on the RTX 5070 Legion 5: gaming 'on par with the more expensive Legion 5 Pro 16'
15.3" WQXGA 165Hz matte IPS: ~500 nits, no PWM flicker, no glossy reflections — the anti-OLED choice for long sessions
20-core Arrow Lake-HX + 32GB handles dev/creative multitasking without the Raptor Lake heat issues
Dual SODIMM/dual M.2/screwed battery — still the most serviceable mainstream gaming laptop
complaints: No Thunderbolt/USB4 on Intel Legion 5 models — the AMD siblings keep USB4 (NBC Gen 10 finding)
IPS contrast and HDR are a clear step down from the OLED siblings despite the 'HDR' label
Fans audible under gaming load (~44-50 dB(A) chassis measurements on this platform)
Speakers mediocre, no card reader (recurring Legion 5 cons)
Legion platform threads: occasional nvlddmkm TDR crashes on 50-series units and slow Lenovo warranty service

standouts: Sale price puts full-TGP RTX 5070 + 32GB + 20-core CPU under $3,050 — the sweet spot of this lineup
design_philosophy: The gaming-leaning twin of the 15.3" Gen 11 Legion 5i: same big matte IPS panel and RAM-loaded configuration but with the RTX 5070 instead of the 5060. It is Lenovo's answer to 'mainstream price, Pro-class gaming', and at the sale price it is the most balanced config of the non-OLED Legion 5 range.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC Legion 5 Gen 10 chassis reviews (87%) per SHARED-legion5-oled.md + IPS deltas per SHARED-legion5-ips.md: +1.1 gaming vs the 5060 twin (172.json) anchored at 7.5 (NBC 5070 'on par with Legion 5 Pro 16'), battery -0.5 vs 5060 tier; 500-nit WQXGA IPS -> screen_quality 6.3 / readability_dark 6.8 (no PWM) / readability_bright 7.0; Intel model lacks USB4 -> port_connectivity 6.8. 15.3" Gen 11 chassis has no dedicated pro review — disclosed.
